founderAuthorization.rule: Add provenance level STANDALONE_LAUNCHER to capture-provider-provenance and the brokers. It is accepted only when launcher path, version and SHA-256 are verified together, and the SHA is rechecked on every broker call. FULL_PACKAGE stays unchanged for npm package installs.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

implementation.capture: When no matching npm package.json is found, a launcher becomes STANDALONE_LAUNCHER only if it is a regular file, --version exits 0 and its whole stdout matches the tool pattern (codex-cli X.Y.Z or X.Y.Z (Claude Code)); otherwise it stays LAUNCHER_ONLY and final is BLOCKED. final PASS requires both tools at FULL_PACKAGE or STANDALONE_LAUNCHER.
implementation.brokers: Both brokers accept only FULL_PACKAGE or STANDALONE_LAUNCHER, keep the per-call launcher SHA-256 check, keep the package.json check for FULL_PACKAGE, and for STANDALONE_LAUNCHER re-run --version on every call and require an exact match with the captured version before spawning the model.
